description: This file defines an Angular component named SidebarComponent, which is a standalone component responsible for managing the sidebar UI, emitting events for new notes and search actions.

classes.name: SidebarComponent
classes.description: An Angular component that manages the sidebar UI, handles user interactions for creating new notes and search queries, and emits corresponding events.

methods.name: onNewNote
methods.description: Emits the 'newNote' event to notify parent components that a new note should be created.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Emits the 'search' event with the query string to perform a search operation.
